name: KNR Constructions Ltd
about: KNR Constructions Ltd, incorporated in 1995, is a Hyderabad-based infrastructure project development company providing EPC services in segments such as roads and highways, irrigation and urban water infrastructure management. [1]
keyPoints:
Service Offerings
The company is a leading EPC service provider with a presence across diverse infrastructure projects, including highways, flyovers, bridges, irrigation systems, urban water infrastructure, and urban development. It executes projects on an EPC, BOT, and Hybrid Annuity Model (HAM) basis. [1]

pros: Stock is trading at 0.96 times its book value
Company has delivered good profit growth of 32.5% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Working capital days have increased from 103 days to 154 days
